'''Clan Alya''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[clan]]. After the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] was purchased by the [[Combined Bothan Clans|Bothan Council]], Clan Alya was one of three clans allowed to settle it. The clan was influential in both Bothan politics and the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]].<ref name="SOESB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Members of the clan who completed their goals in life acquired the "y'lya" honorific.<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

Alya was chosen to colonize [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], was owing to its specilization in shipping, [[mining/Legends|mining]] and construction, bringing along its businesses, and portfolios of trade contacts. The construction of the colony's infrastructure was completed thanks to the know-how and labor provided by Alya. It was the second largest clan on the planet after [[clan Balya]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Being one of the founding clans, Alya members could occupy positions in the [[Bothan Colonial Board]] of Kothlis, and one additional member represented the clan.<ref name="guide" />

By far the most famous member of the clan was [[Borsk Fey'lya]]; after 65% of Alya's population followed him to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Batle of Yavin]], [[clan Ilya]] became the second largest clan on Kothlis.<ref name="guide" />

Borsk became [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]] and [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Another notable member was [[Koth Melan]], the leader of the Bothan Spynet during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SOESB" />
